title: Kit Green knew Ransone but refuses to talk

tellings.quote: he knew Vallee Ransone really well and

plain: Kit Green, a former CIA scientist, is said to have known a woman named Valerie Ransone well during the 1970s and early 1980s, yet refuses to speak about her. An unnamed researcher who appears on the show tells this from his own dealings, saying "he knew Ransone really well." The silence matters to the teller because Green could confirm parts of her story if he chose.
